gray = img.convert('L')

# Apply threshold

# Use tesseract with config

text = pytesseract.image_to_string(gray, config=custom_config)
print("=== OCR output ===")
print(text)

print("\n=== Detected words ===")
for i in range(len(data['text'])):
    if data['text'][i].strip():
        print(f"{data['text'][i]} ({data['left'][i]},{data['top'][i]})")

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = Image.open("chart.jpg")
img_gray = img.convert('L')
data = np.array(img_gray)
height, width = data.shape
# threshold for non-white (less than 250)
nonwhite = data < 250
# find rows with non-white pixels
rows = np.any(nonwhite, axis=1)
cols = np.any(nonwhite, axis=0)
top = np.argmax(rows)
bottom = height - 1 - np.argmax(rows[::-1])
left = np.argmax(cols)
right = width - 1 - np.argmax(cols[::-1])
print(f"Non-white bounding box: left={left}, top={top}, right={right}, bottom={bottom}")
# Crop to this region
crop = img.crop((left, top, right, bottom))
crop.save("nonwhite_crop.png")
print(f"Cropped size: {crop.size}")
# Now try OCR on this crop to see if any hidden text
import pytesseract
text = pytesseract.image_to_string(crop, config='--oem 3 --psm 6')
print("OCR on crop:")
print(text)
